newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease in slow trade.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.12 percent on low turnover on Monday and traders said investors were holding their breath ahead of the formation of a new goverment.
* The 10-share SBI index fell 1.35 points to 1,158.7.
* Turnover fell to 66.8 million tolars from 110.5 million.
* Overall seven shares fell, six rose and one remained unchanged, while another 11 were untraded. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
